beats.say: Kagi has opened its privacy-focused email service, Kagi Mail, to a public beta. To deliver the experience we believe in, we built the full stack: hosting for your addresses and domains, plus the mail and calendar apps.
If you’ve already swapped Google Search for Kagi and Chrome for Orion, your inbox is probably the last big piece of your digital life still at Google.
Kagi Mail also has to treat you the way Kagi Search and Orion do: no surveillance, no ads, open standards, and no lock-in.
